title: •All Wrapped Up
caption: •All Wrapped Up (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Double Back is a Used Interrupt. Once per turn, may ▲ Bounty. If present, your bounty hunter may capture a character opponent just forfeited at same site. Whenever you collect a bounty, may place that Effect out of play to take a retrieved card into hand. {alter}
lore: A capture cable is a quick and effective way for bounty hunters to suddenly snare their target.

notes: Unique. Banner EFFECT, no grabber box. Slip prints ▲ where the stub expands 'Take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'; red circle-slash A at the end → {alter}. Slip text otherwise matches the stub. Lore matches the wiki and both scans.
